description: Link to the ZapX order page with the configuration preselected (product, plan or resources, game, location, billing cycle); same arguments as preview_order, plus locale (the user's language). The user signs up or signs in and pays on that page. Works without sign-in; use it whenever the user wants to order and cannot or does not want to order in the chat. Creates nothing.

billingCycleSlug.description: Billing cycle: 3-day, monthly, quarterly, semi-annual or annual.

configuration.description: Product-specific configuration, same shape as the REST order body.

locale.description: Language of the order page, the user's language: de, en, fr, es, it, pl, pt, nl, ... Default de.

planSlug.description: Plan slug from list_orderable_plans (products with fixed plans).

regionSlug.description: Region slug from list_orderable_product_regions (products with region choice).

resourceConfig.description: Resource values for configurable products, keyed as listed by list_orderable_plans.

name: create_checkout_link
title: Create Prefilled Order Link
